SQL.nvtx: SELECT n.start,n.end,n.globalTid,n.endGlobalTid,n.rangeId,n.uint64Value,COALESCE(n.text,s.value) AS label FROM NVTX_EVENTS n LEFT JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=n.textId WHERE n.end IS NOT NULL ORDER BY n.start
SQL.runtime: SELECT r.*,s.value AS api FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=r.nameId ORDER BY r.start
SQL.streams: SELECT f.value,c.value FROM ProcessStreams p JOIN StringIds f ON f.id=p.filenameId JOIN StringIds c ON c.id=p.contentId
